questions.question_text: What is a key factor to consider when selecting a venue for a school event like a talent show?

options.text: Picking the most expensive location to impress attendees
Ensuring the space can accommodate the expected number of people
Choosing a venue far from school to make it exciting
Ignoring accessibility since everyone can figure out how to get there

correct_answer.text: Ensuring the space can accommodate the expected number of people

questions.question_text: Which item would likely be included in an equipment checklist for a school sports day?

options.text: A personal diary for writing thoughts
A first-aid kit for handling minor injuries
A stack of novels for reading during breaks

correct_answer.text: A first-aid kit for handling minor injuries

questions.question_text: What is an effective strategy when negotiating with a vendor for event supplies like food or decor?

options.text: Accepting the first price quoted without discussion
Politely asking for a discount or free extras since it’s a school event
Demanding a lower price without explaining your budget
Avoiding contact with vendors and hoping they lower prices on their own

correct_answer.text: Politely asking for a discount or free extras since it’s a school event

questions.question_text: Why is it important to secure permissions before hosting a school event?

options.text: To make the event look more professional on social media
To avoid last-minute cancellations and ensure compliance with school or local rules
To spend extra money on unnecessary paperwork
To complicate the planning process for no reason

correct_answer.text: To avoid last-minute cancellations and ensure compliance with school or local rules
